negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, CGI, 3D digital render, smooth plastic skin, airbrushed digital art, vector illustration, cel shading, shiny plastic doll, human child face, realistic biological human skin, deformed hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, modern bright fluorescent lighting, harsh digital flash
reconstruction_priority: tactile stop-motion material authenticity — AI typically defaults to smooth plastic CGI or generic digital painting instead of porous clay and fuzzy yarn
caricatured facial anatomy with oversized smooth bulbous nose and large translucent ear — AI tends to normalize into standard human proportions or distorted monster features
intricate chunky wool knit stitches and physical yarn ribbing on beanies and sweater — AI often renders flat painted patterns instead of true 3D woven yarn geometry
shallow macro depth-of-field with precise focal plane on the reaching hand and orange beanie — AI frequently renders flat overall focus across all planes
